title: Confirm these exact changes?
message:
One atomic connected change corrects the existing surviving target title to Optics calibration lamp E2-V73, serial to E2-V73 and disambiguation to Verified synthetic marking E2-V73, then merges Violet lamp sleeve Ω into that target. Both stable IDs and original revisions remain; the source becomes a redirect, original names remain discoverable, and historical references are preserved. This applies only to these synthetic fixtures, never Anton or T31.

Alternatives: Leave both originals unchanged; correct the existing target without merging; or keep both identities separate pending further verification. None of these alternatives is included in this proposal.

Update entity “Optics calibration lamp”:
Title: Optics calibration lamp → Optics calibration lamp E2-V73
aliases: none → Optics calibration lamp
disambiguation: Unverified synthetic marking description; serial unknown. → Verified synthetic marking E2-V73
external records: serial: unknown → serial: E2-V73

Merge entity “Violet lamp sleeve Ω” into “Optics calibration lamp E2-V73”.
